name: studyleague-poc
description: Prueba de concepto de StudyLeague: arquitectura orientada a eventos con Apache Kafka (TP Integrador Final, Ingeniería de Software II).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @studyleague/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @studyleague/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d kafka kafka-init kafka-ui postgres redis
scripts.seed:ranking: npm run build -w @studyleague/shared && npm run seed -w @studyleague/seed-ranking --
